name: yg3-marketing-mcp
description: Marketing MCP: content, SEO, outbound, LinkedIn, and ads (206 tools).
long_description:
Connect to YG3 marketing operations at https://mcp.yg3.ai/mcp.

**Human path:** leave the workspace token blank — mcp-remote will run OAuth (https://www.yg3.ai/connect).

**Agent path:** paste a Bearer token from POST https://agency.yg3.ai/api/v1/workspaces.

Docs: https://www.yg3.ai/for-agents · Repo: https://github.com/YG3-ai/yg3-mcp · Registry: io.github.YG3-ai/yg3-mcp

yg3_token.title: YG3 workspace token (optional)
yg3_token.description: Bearer token from POST https://agency.yg3.ai/api/v1/workspaces. Leave blank to sign in with OAuth instead (https://www.yg3.ai/connect).
